title: ChargingKey
description: Represents a charging key assigned to a user account.

keyId.description: Identifier used for this charging key (`uid` in the case of a physical charging key)

referenceId.description: Visual number for RFID and virtual keys, Plug and Charge identifier (PCID )for plug_and_charge keys

contractId.description: Identifier used in the context of roaming

name.description: Key name (usually set by end-users to name their keys when they have multiple ones).

validFrom.description: UTC timestamp when the charging key becomes valid.

validTo.description: UTC timestamp when the charging key expires.

type.description: Possible values include, but aren't limited to: 'tag', 'card', 'virtual', 'plug_and_charge'.

enabled.description: Indicates if the key can start a session or not

created.description: UTC timestamp when the charging key was created.

updated.description: UTC timestamp when the charging key was last updated.

whitelist.description: Defines whether the CPO may allow a session for this charging key when it cannot get a response from the EMP, or must always rely on realtime authorization from the EMP. Possible values: ALLOWED_OFFLINE, NEVER.

DriveApiChargingKeyWhitelistType.description:
Defines when authorization of a charging key by the CPO is allowed.
ALLOWED_OFFLINE: CPO should use realtime authorization. But when the CPO cannot get a response from the eMSP, the CPO shall allow the charging key to be used.
NEVER: Only realtime authorization is allowed. CPO shall always send a realtime authorization for any use of this charging key to the MSP.
